    {"name": "Gemini 4", "url": null},
    {"name": "Locally Uncensored", "url": null},
    {"name": "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash", "url": null}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "CHINA / CHINA DISRUPTS THE AI MARKET / CHINA DISRUPTS THE AI MARKET / MODEL, / AND / GENERATION / VIDEO · REAL CLIPS MADE IN THE APP / GENERATION / AND A / FREE ON / PC. / THIS / VIDEO, / SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer / A 2.6B open-source world model that turns one image and a camera trajectory into 720p, minute-long, controllable video on a single GPU. / Haoyi Zhu, Haozhe Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Tian Ye, Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Tong He, Song Han, Enze Xie / NVIDIA / ONLINE DEMO / PAPER / CODE / MODELS / MODEL. / AND IT / 720P / PentAGI / GPU. / SANDBOX / REPORT. / beam — The Operating System for AI Transformation / Beam turns the work your company does by hand into processes that run themselves and get better with every correction. / Book a demo / MODEL. / Discover / See which work is worth automating / Beam maps the processes in a department by volume and cost, so the first agent you build is the one that pays back fastest / Learn more / 5.2. / Remote access / Scan the QR code / Enter the 6-digit code / Type the 6-digit code / Your PC does the work / WITH NO / FILES. / Eval Results / Deploy / Copy to bucket / Use this model / Model card / Files / Community / AND",
  "key_claims": [
    "China released the world's most powerful open-source AI agent model, rivaling frontier proprietary models, for free",
    "The tool runs chat, image generation, video generation, and a coding agent entirely free on your own PC",
    "SANA-WM is a 2.6 billion parameter open-source world model that turns an image, text prompt, and camera path into a full minute of explorable 720p video on a single GPU",
    "PentAGI is an open-source team of AI agents that security-tests systems: it plans work from a plain-English goal, runs tools like Nmap and Metasploit in a sandbox, and produces a report",
    "Reflection AI open-sourced Beam, a 501 billion parameter coding and agent model, scoring around 80% on terminal bench while using about a third of the tokens of GLM 5.2",
    "Google released Gemini 4 to everyone, its most capable model yet, built for long coding and agent tasks with a 1 million token context window",
    "'Locally Uncensored' is a free desktop app for Windows and Linux combining chat, image generation, video generation, and a coding agent, running entirely on-device with no terminal or config files",
    "DeepSeek open-sourced V4.1 Flash, 552 billion parameters with only 16 billion active at a time, adding live web search and outperforming GLM 5.3 and DPT 5.6 on benchmarks, completely free"
  ],
  "info_channel": "spoken"
}
